standard: MASA 1.1.1.1 / CWE-922 / ASVS V6.4.1 (Secure Platform Token Storage)

findings.detail: Headless Chrome dump found observed/bearer token persisted in plaintext browser localStorage['token'] (redacted len=760; violates OAU-07 / MASA 1.1.1.1 / CWE-922).
Headless Chrome document.cookie exposed token-bearing cookie 'token' (len=760) lacking HttpOnly/Secure flags (violates OAU-07 / CWE-922).
Token-bearing cookie 'token' at http://localhost:3000/rest/user/login lacks required attributes ['HttpOnly', 'Secure', 'SameSite=Lax|Strict', 'Server-Issued Set-Cookie'] (OAU-07).
http://localhost:3000/main.js writes OAuth/authentication token to browser localStorage via localStorage.setItem() (CWE-922).
http://localhost:3000/main.js stores OAuth/session cookie via client-side JavaScript cookie writer without HttpOnly/Secure enforcement (CWE-922).
frontend/src/app/login/login.component.ts writes OAuth/authentication token to browser localStorage via localStorage.setItem() (CWE-922).
frontend/src/app/login/login.component.ts stores OAuth/session cookie via client-side JavaScript cookie writer without HttpOnly/Secure enforcement (CWE-922).
frontend/src/app/oauth/oauth.component.ts writes OAuth/authentication token to browser localStorage via localStorage.setItem() (CWE-922).
frontend/src/app/oauth/oauth.component.ts stores OAuth/session cookie via client-side JavaScript cookie writer without HttpOnly/Secure enforcement (CWE-922).
frontend/src/app/two-factor-auth-enter/two-factor-auth-enter.component.ts invokes localStorage.setItem('token', ...) for OAuth/access token persistence instead of HttpOnly; Secure cookies (CWE-922).
frontend/src/app/payment/payment.component.ts invokes localStorage.setItem('token', ...) for OAuth/access token persistence instead of HttpOnly; Secure cookies (CWE-922).
